title: Dose by Dose
subtitle: A GLP-1 Weight Loss Journal: 6-Month Tracker for Weekly Shots or Daily Pills with Side Effects, Protein, Water, Food Log, Weigh-Ins and Doctor Visit Notes
categories: Health, Fitness & Dieting > Diets & Weight Loss
description_html:
Every dose, every week, one place.

Dose by Dose keeps the first six months of your GLP-1 medication organised: what you took and where, how your body reacted, what you ate and how far you have come. Bring it to appointments and answer your care team's questions in seconds.

  • 26 weekly check-ins: dose, time, injection site or pill, weigh-in and measurements
  • Side-effect grid: rate 10 common symptoms (nausea, constipation, reflux, fatigue and more) from 0 to 3 every day
  • Daily habits table: protein, water, fibre, fruit and veg, movement, sleep
  • 7-day food log with protein per day
  • Monthly progress pages with a weight graph, photo boxes and measurements
  • Injection site rotation map, titration planner, care-team contacts
  • Doctor visit pages, symptom and questions log, protein-first food ideas, six-month review

Works for weekly injections or daily pills. 6 x 9 inches, 104 pages, matte cover.

A tracking journal only, not medical advice. Always follow your care team's instructions. Not connected with any drug maker.
